text_block_list.text:
—Hmm. Laurel-san moisturizes with a 
treatment before blow-drying with a 
dedicated brush. Sky-san merely runs her 
fingers through her hair to roughly dry 
it...

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
...Hey, Laurel-san. Don't you feel someone 
giving us an intensely hot gaze from over 
there?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha, true enough. Um... Lois-chan, do 
you need something?

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, pardon me! I just couldn't help but 
wonder about your hair care routines.

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
Laurel-san, Sky-san. Both of you have such 
soft, supple-looking hair, after all.

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
I simply had to analyze the secret behind 
it! Having beautiful hair is a wonderful 
characteristic that could surely be 
utilized in self-producing, too.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, so that's what it was. But I don't 
really do any special care, you know? If 
you're asking about hair softness, it's 
probably—

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, vegetables! And so many of them...! 
Your grandpa sent more over, didn't he?

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Yeah~, it's quite the bumper crop this 
time. Now then, I wonder if we can finish 
eating them all while they're still fresh.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
Since they're freshly picked, after all. 
Sweet, juicy... fufu, the vegetables from 
last time were delicious too♪

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
...There's daikon radish, carrots, and 
even purple cabbage. Hey, would it be 
alright if I made a salad with these 
vegetables?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
Vegetable sticks served with vinaigrette 
sauce... Here you go, enjoy♪

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Ohoho, this is... Delish~♪

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
The juicy sweetness of hearty, well-grown 
veggies! Truly feels like a bounty of 
nature.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, right? I dialed back the honey and 
focused on vinegar to bring out the 
natural sweetness of the vegetables.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
Your grandpa's vegetables have such rich 
flavor, don't they? You really want to 
savor the quality of the raw ingredients♪

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
You sure know your stuff. They're plenty 
delicious as they are, of course, but—

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Changing up the flavor with the dressing 
just keeps my hands reaching for more. 
Man, I could eat this forever~♪

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
I'm glad you like it! Sky-chan, you're 
always sharing vegetables with me, after 
all.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
Making a little dressing is something I 
can do anytime♪

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
—So, maybe that's why. Freshly picked 
vegetables are packed with nutrition and 
great for your health. Which means great 
for your hair too, of course.

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
I see, dietary habits... and specifically 
the high quality of the vegetables was the 
secret! What fantastic information!

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Hehehe. Well then, next time a shipment 
arrives, maybe I'll launch an ambush on 
Lois-chan too~

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
—And so, it's practically proven. 
Improving your diet makes hair care so 
much more effective♪

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
While browsing for hair care products at a 
store, I bumped into Sakura Laurel by 
chance and received some advice on hair 
maintenance from her.
choice_data_list: Thanks, I'll give that a try next time!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
Yes, please do! Let's eat delicious food 
and get healthy hair together.
